desc_en: Ni-dominant: uses intuition to see the big picture and long-term direction, with Te-auxiliary turning ideas into executable plans. Independent and goal-driven, prefers to think things through alone before acting, and has little patience for inefficiency and ambiguity.
desc_zh: Ni 主导：习惯用直觉洞察全局与长远走向，Te 辅助把构想拆成可执行方案。独立、目标感强，倾向于自己把事想透再行动，对低效和含糊缺乏耐心。
